messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: streaming-tail.p99 > 2s for /v1/stream (eu-west-1) — spike started at 12:42:11 UTC, source=streaming-proxy. Alert ID: AB-4123
alice: I'm on call. Investigating. Checking proxy queue depth and recent deploys.
bob: I see a deployment to streaming-proxy in eu-west-1 12:35 UTC (rollout v2.3.7). Can you check proxy logs + 5xx?
cara: Also saw elevated client backpressure metrics (slow consumers) from a few customers. Rolling window shows avg consumer read time 700ms -> 2.5s.
alice: Running quick health checks: `curl -sS http://proxy-eu-west1/health` -> OK, but `/metrics` shows queue_depth=1240, p95_write=1.8s
alice: Dumping tail of proxy logs:
```
kubectl -n streaming logs -l app=streaming-proxy --tail=100 | grep "write_timeout"
```
alice: Found repeated "write timeout to client" and "can't flush chunk" errors 12:36-12:43.
bob: Any config changes? runbook says check keepalive and chunk_size. I see keepalive timeout reduced in configmap yesterday.
cara: That config rollback likely triggered more frequent connection churn. Suggest revert to keepalive:30s -> 60s and bump proxy write buffer.
alice: Can we scale proxy pool by 2 now? `kubectl scale deploy streaming-proxy --replicas=6 -n streaming`
emma: Scaling now. `kubectl patch deploy streaming-proxy -n streaming -p '{"spec":{"replicas":6}}'` :white_check_mark: 
incident-bot: Pager notification sent to SRE rotation: paged emma at 12:44:05 UTC.
dave: CS reporting 3 customers with streaming timeouts (support-112, support-118, support-121). Marking as potentially impacted.
alice: Triggering canary fallback to polling for affected routes to reduce streaming pressure: flipping feature flag `enable_stream_fallback=true` for eu-west-1.
cara: Also enabling prefix KV caching for frequent prompts; should reduce token regen and backend load.
bob: After scaling + revert keepalive, queue_depth down to ~300, p99 tail improved to 420ms in next 30s window.
alice: Can we keep watch for 15 minutes and run an SLO impact calc? I'm collecting p95/p99 snapshots and request counts.
dave: I'll reach out to the 3 customers with a brief note: "We're investigating intermittent streaming timeouts; temporary mitigation in place. We'll follow up with root cause"
emma: Oncall handoff scheduled at 13:00 UTC to @frank. I'll include notes in the incident channel and add follow-up tasks: check config rollout history, add canary gating on keepalive.
alice: Adding next steps: (1) revert config in git (PR #4521), (2) add e2e streaming test with slow consumer sim, (3) perf regression alert on config changes.
cara: Root cause hypothesis: recent keepalive/conn-churn change reduced effective write window which coupled with heavy slow-consumer clients -> proxy buffering and write timeouts -> increased tail. Will validate logs + deployments.
alice: If p99 regresses above 1.5s again we escalate to SEV2. For now status: mitigating, customer impact limited, monitoring. :thumbsup: 
frank: I'll take post-mortem and own follow-ups after handoff. Thanks all.
bob: FYI I added a short Grafana dashboard panel showing client read latency and proxy write queue; useful for future alerts.
incident-bot: Incident update: mitigations applied at 12:46:10 UTC, status=watching."
